Definition: Whether government taxes, customs duties, and other revenue can be paid using the instant digital payment system, indicating integration of payment infrastructure with tax administration systems.
Comments: Value=2 (Partial). Burundi has digital tax/fee payment capability via OBR telepayment referenced in the SCIRP paper, but e-KORI (online filing and payment) was described as being launched for development/rollout in phases in 2026, implying revenue collection digitization is present but not fully mature/universal.

Definition: Whether the instant payment system supports direct person-to-person transfer of funds between individuals for informal transactions, remittances, and interpersonal value transfers.
Comments: Value=2 (Yes). Mobile money operators Ecocash and Lumicash provide person-to-person transfers; the UNCDF report notes mobile money and limited remittance-related P2P use cases, and the SCIRP paper documents transfers volumes in Burundi’s mobile financial services.

Definition: Percentage of the adult population (15+ years) who have made at least one digital payment transaction through the instant payment system in the past 90 days, indicating active usage rather than just account ownership.
Comments: Value=1 (<20%). Mobile financial services penetration in Burundi was reported at ~16.84% in 2022 (and 17.21% in Dec 2023) in the SCIRP study; UNCDF also reports mobile money active subscriber share (31% of 4.64m subscribers active in 2021) but population-level penetration remains below 20%.

Definition: Percentage of government payments (G2P disbursements including salaries, pensions, social transfers) made through instant digital payment system rather than cash or check, reflecting government adoption and modernization.
Comments: Value=1 (<20%). Evidence points to partial/limited digitization of government payments/collections (e.g., UNHCR mobile money cash assistance pilots; OBR telepayment; e-KORI under development), but no evidence of majority of government payments being digitized nationwide.
